segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or flaky skin report the lotion is lighter than a cream but still clears dry patches and flaky spots, though one notes it may be too thin for severely dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers say it calms redness and does not break them out, but one sensitive-skin reviewer reports it caused acne and warns others with sensitive skin away from it.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as non-oily, gentle, and non-breakout-inducing in daily use.
segments.normal: One reviewer notes normal/dry-combo skin works well with this lotion, though it may be too thin for very dry skin.

concerns.redness: Several postpartum reviewers with sensitive/combination skin say redness was reduced within two uses and describe it as effective for chronic facial redness.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin report dry, flaky patches and winter dryness were cleared or reduced, with skin left hydrated rather than greasy.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer's children with eczema saw dry patches nearly gone after one use, suggesting a soothing effect on compromised skin.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or combination skin, report no new breakouts; however one sensitive-skin reviewer reports the product caused acne and another reports closed comedones and blackheads.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with acne-prone tendencies reports the product caused closed comedones and blackheads, attributing this to comedogenic ingredients like Ethylhexyl Stearate and Glyceryl Stearate.

aspects.libelle: Too thin for severely dry skin

extraits.titre: Cosed comedones, blackheads, and ingrown hairs
extraits.texte: I really wanted to like this product, but unfortunately, it did not work for my skin at all. After applying it to my face, I started developing closed comedones and blackheads. I also tried using it on my legs, and it caused ingrown hairs in areas that were previously clear. After checking the ingredients, I realized it contains Ethylhexyl Stearate and Glyceryl Stearate, which are known to be comedogenic. These ingredients seem to have clogged my pores and sealed in debris, causing irritation and breakouts. If you're acne-prone or prone to ingrown hairs, I'd recommend avoiding this product, especially on areas you shave or exfoliate. Definitely not repurchasing.
